text:
maria: Quick week0 catch-up for Lazuli private/VPC onboarding. Summary: VPCs and route tables done; peering awaiting customer firewall thumbs-up; IAM needs tight assume-role principals; KMS must be HSM-backed with rotation proof; audit logs to customer Splunk HEC, retention ask is 7y immutable which is above our default. Please list immediate blockers and owners.

jonah: Networking update: subnets & RTs validated, transit gateway attached, flow logs enabled. Waiting on customer firewall team to accept peering and provide BGP ASN for the tunnel. Open ticket INF-4399.

tara: KMS note: customer insists on HSM-backed CMK (FIPS 140-2/3). They want rotation every 2 years and an audit trail showing key usage per request. Drafting policy and proof checklist. We'll need either CloudHSM or AWS KMS with external key material + attestation.

sam: For audit logs: they want logs forwarded to their Splunk with indexed sourcetypes and 7y retention in immutable WORM. Do we support object-lock S3 or a signed archival workflow? Pricing will need to be discussed.

alex: Renewal risk flagged: 7y immutability request could be a blocker for renewals if we can't offer contract language. I can loop in legal & pricing. Also suggest a fallback: 3y standard + paid add-on for 7y WORM storage and compliance attestation.

maria: Actions: jonah -> chase peering acceptance and BGP details (owner: jonah, due Tue EOD). tara -> post KMS policy draft + evidence options (owner: tara, due Wed noon). sam -> collect Splunk HEC endpoint, sourcetype mapping, and retention SLA expectation (owner: sam, due Wed EOD). alex -> update account health doc, estimate renewal risk impact, schedule cross-functional call Fri 10am PT (owner: alex). CS bot create follow-ups.

cs_bot: Created ticket CS-9002 "Lazuli week0 follow-ups: peering, KMS HSM evidence, audit retention" assigned to alex.

jonah: Quick snippet I used to validate flow logs landing in staging S3: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-staging-logs/lazuli/ --recursive | tail -n 5`. Need customer's Splunk HEC + token to configure forwarding.

tara: Policy excerpt I'll share in the ticket; high-level: explicit `sts:AssumeRole` trust to their account ID only, KMS policy allowing Redwood service role with least privilege, and requirement for HSM key origin.

sam: Pricing note: object-lock + long-term storage estimate roughly +12% on top of base storage; will confirm after we get retention byte estimates.

alex: I'll draft the customer-facing note offering two tracks (native 7y WORM add-on vs hybrid archive + attestation) and share before Fri so legal/pricing can weigh in. :eyes:

maria: Thanks team. I'll paste this recap into Lazuli onboarding doc and ping the account once we have the Fri call invite. If anything blocks earlier, post here. :thumbsup:
